# Removing the copied headers attribute leaves the bounded raw-header API

Fresh full three-file patch read. It removes the unused IDL headers attribute and its GetHeaders implementation, which assembled a newly allocated CRLF string from the internal buffer. GetAllHeaders remains a distinct pointer-and-length API. The added store comment explains why the copy shortcut can be unavailable for mbox; it does not add a new shortcut implementation. Fixed GetAllHeaders returns the parser-owned buffer and explicit length after checking the two output pointers. The needed IMAP consumer checks success/header presence and wraps the bounded buffer in nsDependentCSubstring before inbox filtering. Reuse the existing borrowed-buffer lesson; do not infer all unrelated GetHeaders methods are gone, null termination, transferred ownership or a project-wide unused-call proof from this patch. The complete umbrella discussion describes progressive parsing/filter/store decoupling and explicitly says the later parser was initially incomplete. Its final closure ends one phase, not proof filtering was already unified or every planned refactor landed here. Brief zero-inline review acceptance and failed/ongoing build status do not establish runtime filtering or copy correctness.

Scope: Message parser header API ownership.
